request: Advanced-route deliverable: space-domain convergence view. Pull the active satellite TLE catalog and the CNEOS Sentry impact-risk catalog. Bucket TLEs into orbital regimes (LEO/MEO/GEO/HEO/cislunar) via TLE line2 mean-motion substring extraction. Publish two DSes to Tableau Cloud under Prep Agent. OpenSky US airspace activity is a dashboard-time join, not a build-time coupling.

sources.name: Active Satellite TLE Catalog (Convergence view)
sources.description: TLE catalog (Space-Track mirror). One row per active tracked satellite. line2 is the standard NORAD TLE line-2 (columns 53-62 contain mean motion in revolutions/day).

args.name: TLE Convergence Trend
args.features_description: Per-satellite TLE catalog with days_since_epoch and mean_motion_str extracted from line2 columns 53-63. Compute orbital regime bucket in Tableau via mean_motion cast to decimal: LEO >= 11.25, MEO 5-11.25, GEO 1.0-1.1, HEO 0.7-5, cislunar < 0.7. Flag stale TLEs (days_since_epoch > 14).
args.stats_description: Long-form per-satellite temporal statistics (limited usefulness given TLE per-satellite record cadence).

outputs.name: Space Convergence Satellite Detail
outputs.description:
Row-level active satellite TLE catalog with days_since_epoch, mean_motion_str (columns 53-63 of TLE line2), and calendar features. Compute orbital_regime and stale-TLE flag in Tableau. Refresh: daily.

Advanced-route notes: 'convergence' is COINCIDENT ANALYST INTEREST + temporal overlap, NOT physical intercept. Real conjunction analysis needs SGP4 propagation and is out of scope. Join at Tableau layer to: (a) 'Space Convergence Asteroid Risk' at time granularity for combined risk views; (b) 'OpenSky US' for airspace-activity demand proxy in the same window. Orbital regime bucket is inferred heuristically from TLE mean motion.
